project.name: TabU-lab
project.tagline: Open research for transferable tabular models

purpose: Investigate whether reconstructing available table evidence learns useful unit-specific relationships and representations that transfer across tables, while producing reusable open research software.

status.next_gate: Define a bounded comparison and its resource budget; assess restoration, transfer, and scaling within separately specified protocols.

claim_boundaries: The public website is not model evidence.
A local or public run is not a benchmark claim without a matching receipt.
A TabU-lab experiment does not by itself validate the broader TabU research program.
Failures remain publishable when their protocol and provenance are complete.

research_support.scope: Candidate work packages; budgets, milestones, data rights and publication terms require project-specific agreement.

evidence.scope: Dated restoration implementation review; no fit or generalization claim.
TabU-TAR fixed-training-table fitting; results do not transfer to the restoration model.
Scoped prepared-execution equivalence and timing checks.
